packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates merge automatically once all CI gates pass (documented G3 exception for dependency hygiene)
Major updates always require human review (Gate G2/G3)
Microsoft.OpenApi 3.x is coupled to ASP.NET Core 11 (the AspNetCore.OpenApi 10 source generator breaks against it on .NET 10); hold at 2.x until the .NET 11 move — tech-debt #62
TypeScript 7 is not supported by Angular 22; hold at 6.x until an Angular release supports it — tech-debt #63
